name: write-document
description: From a brief to a finished document: outline, (approval), write and build with real styles, render-and-fix, independent review, up to two revision rounds, PDF export and a delivery note.

brief.description: What the document must achieve: purpose, key content, data or source files in the workspace.

style.default: professional report: Calibri, one accent colour, numbered headings

approval.description: "manual" to approve the outline before building, "auto" to go straight on

outline.title: Storyline & outline
outline.prompt:
Write the document outline to docs/doc-outline.md.

<brief>
{{input.brief}}
</brief>

Audience: {{input.audience}}. Length: {{input.length}}.
Feedback on an earlier outline, if any: {{feedback}}

Report: the storyline in three lines and the assumptions.

approve-outline.title: Approve the outline
approve-outline.message:
The outline is ready. Approve to build the document, or send it back with what to change.

{{state.outline}}

build.title: Build the document

fix.title: Fix render problems
fix.prompt:
The render checks failed. Fix the build script (not by shrinking text: cut, split or re-layout), re-run it, render the pages to confirm, and export the PDF again.

{{feedback}}

review.title: Independent review

revise.title: Revise

fix-2.title: Fix render problems
fix-2.prompt:
The render checks failed after the revision. Fix it (not by shrinking text), re-render to confirm, export the PDF.

{{feedback}}

final-review.title: Second review
final-review.prompt: Second review of {{input.file}}. Render every page. Check that each BLOCKING and MAJOR finding in docs/doc-review.md is resolved and that nothing new broke. Append a "Round 2" section to docs/doc-review.md.

revise-2.title: Final revision
revise-2.prompt:
Fix the findings in the "Round 2" section of docs/doc-review.md; re-render, export the PDF.

{{state.final-review}}

deliver.title: Delivery note
deliver.prompt: Write docs/delivery.md: the files delivered ({{input.file}} and its PDF), the section list and page count, what the reviews found and how each BLOCKING/MAJOR finding was resolved (from docs/doc-review.md), the assumptions made, and anything left open. Report its first paragraph.
